transport.description: A process-local row must declare verdictCap; check-proof-row-manifests.mjs refuses a declared transport outside this list rather than read it as not process-local, and grade-preflight-gated-row.mjs refuses a manifest without one (lib/row-verdict-cap.mjs).

status.description: Runnable means scenario.file/name resolves to tools/k6-proofs/scenarios/*.js. Scaffold/construct-only rows are intentional non-runnable manifest entries.

file.description: Runnable scenario file basename under tools/k6-proofs/scenarios/.

expectedFile.description: Planned scenario file basename for scaffold rows. The file is not expected to exist yet.

invocation.description: Row-specific fire parameters consumed by the scenario (tool, forms, delay, prompt template, idempotency prefix). A row run by a script instead of its k6 scenario names that runner here and declares the runner's artifact class in artifactClass; lib/row-verdict-cap.mjs reads the class from that declaration, never from the key that names the runner.

fixture.description: A process-local fixture. The row must declare verdictCap (artifactClass process-local-fixture), and it may not declare artifactClass disposable-real-process.

control.description: A runner whose class artifactClass declares. Without artifactClass it is read as a process-local fixture, so the row must declare verdictCap.

artifactClass.description: The artifact class of the runner. process-local-fixture must declare verdictCap. disposable-real-process (a runner that starts, restarts and stops a real gateway process it set up for the run, never the live one, as R-CD-RETURN-COVENANT-AUTHORITY's restart control does) is not capped, and check-proof-row-manifests.mjs refuses it on a process-local or missing transport, beside fixture, without control, or on a row the ruling caps by id (R-CW-5, R-CW-6). Any other value is refused.

seatClassExpectation.description: Per-seat-class expected artifact classes for rows whose provable ceiling depends on the seat's final-text surface.

sourceContract.description: Exact-SHA source-contract binding for rows proven against committed product source rather than a live gateway.

requiredPreflights.description: Required preflight attachments of this live row (🌊's F″ method ruling, Discord 1565895695586558120). Each names a static check that must run at the exact candidate and pass there. A passing preflight is necessary, not sufficient: it never lifts the row above its verdictCap. A missing, failed, malformed or other-SHA receipt caps the row at PARTIAL-candidate. Enforced by grade-preflight-gated-row.mjs and validate-corpus.mjs; check-proof-row-manifests.mjs keeps it in agreement with the preflight manifest's preflightAttachment.

manifest.description: The preflight's row manifest basename under tools/k6-proofs/manifests/.

binding.description: The preflight reads PROOFS/<candidate>/ and its receipt's candidateSha and sourceEvidenceSha must equal this row's candidate. Never the INDEX static_evidence_sha.

passVerdict.description: The verdict a passing preflight run emits: the preflight manifest's liveRunSafety.expectedArtifactClass.

capOnMissingOrFailed.description: The highest verdict this row may carry while the preflight is missing or not passed.

receipt.description: The receipt file the preflight run writes (schema openclaw.k6.required-preflight-receipt.v1).

verdictCap.description: The highest verdict this row may carry, declared machine-readably (🌊's ruling on docs#616, Discord 1565925290008387728). The row verdict is the minimum of the fixture's or harness's verdict, this cap and the preflight cap; a passing required preflight is necessary, not sufficient, and never lifts it. A process-local row must declare it (check-proof-row-manifests.mjs). Enforced by grade-preflight-gated-row.mjs and validate-corpus.mjs (rows-within-declared-cap); the rules live in lib/row-verdict-cap.mjs.

rowCap.description: The cap. A row recorded above it (corpus state pass) fails validation without an adopted superseding authority.

artifactClass.description: The artifact class the cap belongs to: process-local-fixture for a process-local row, otherwise the class invocation.artifactClass declares.

supersedingAuthorities.description: Superseding authorities the method has adopted. Lifting the cap needs a superseding authority receipt from a different artifact class, adopted by an explicit method change; none is adopted. Adopting one widens this schema and teaches validate-corpus.mjs and grade-preflight-gated-row.mjs to judge its receipt.

preflightAttachment.description: Marks this manifest as a required preflight attachment of a live row rather than a proof row. An F″ corpus records it under proofs-manifest preflight_attachments, never in rows[] or required_rows; corpora folded before the ruling keep it as the row they folded.

attachedTo.description: The live row whose requiredPreflights names this manifest.

proofRow.description: Retired as a proof row for new corpora.

telemetryContract.description: Telemetry rebind contract (karmaterminal/openclaw#1254). Declares the product spans/attributes a row's claim rests on, whether the product emits them today, and what a later independent observer needs to re-derive the same slice. A row may only claim a telemetry-rebindable PASS when every identity and proof-run marker is declared emitted by the product.

remedyConcern.description: Set only on the cross-cutting remedy rows. Each concern is owned by exactly one row so the split cannot silently lose a census finding.

enforcement.description: advisory records unproven rebind receipts in row-result.json without changing the row's behavioral verdict. blocking caps the row below PASS-candidate until every rebindReceipt is explicitly present.

rebindable.description: True only when an independent observer could re-derive this row's claim from committed telemetry alone.

productInstrumentationPrerequisite.description: True when the contract cannot be satisfied until OpenClaw emits the declared attributes/spans.

prerequisiteRows.description: Remedy rows that must land before this row can become rebindable.

rebindReceipts.description: Receipt names that must be explicitly present before a telemetry-rebindable claim is allowed.

treatZeroAsAbsence.description: A degraded backend that answers 200 with zero results is never evidence of absence.

classification.description: Static/preflight-only rows never fire the live gateway; k6-runnable rows may be started by run-proof.sh; orchestration-required rows need an external agent/tool/human step and are rejected by the live-run guard; construct-only rows document planned/non-runnable proof contracts and are also rejected by the live-run guard.

requiresCandidateSha.description: True when OPENCLAW_CANDIDATE_SHA must be present and a 40-character hex SHA before the row can run.

requiresExternalAgentOrToolInvocation.description: True when k6 REST/WS alone is not enough and an agent/tool invocation outside the raw k6 transport is required.

requiresHumanConfirmation.description: True when a human must confirm the row before or during the fire.

requiresDisposableSession.description: True when the row must run against a disposable session rather than a long-lived seat session.

sameSessionConcurrencySafe.description: False means do not run this row concurrently against the same target session unless the row explicitly proves concurrency behavior.

expectedArtifactClass.description: The highest artifact class this run should emit before maintainer review/fold.
